name: Paradise Farm RV Park
note: Small seasonal RV park on Route 230 (Discovery Trail) near Bonavista, in an open loop beside a pond; 30- and 50-amp sites with water, dump station, washrooms with hot showers. Campers report ~C$40 a night (2025). A September 2025 camper was told the campground would be closing - confirm it is open before going (noted 2026-10-07). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: no operator website; Google listing at the pin, 4.1 over 90 reviews with phone; RV Life 4.5* over 57 reviews, $$ (C$31 avg ~ US$22, passes the Canada screen); Campendium firsthand stays 2019-2025 at C$35-40; caveat: a 2025-09-23 Campendium reviewer was told it would be closing (read 2026-10-07)
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 48.5830,-53.0909: site loop on open grass; a pond lies ~30-40 m west/southwest of the loop's west edge behind a strip of trees; a 2023 camper reports a view over the lake; no site on the shore - lakeview

name: Kona Beach Park
note: Family campground on a sandy lake beach beside the Trans-Canada at South Brook, ~96 sites with electric and water, many along the beach. Showers, laundry, store, playground, dump station, paddle boat/kayak rentals. Open late May-September. Campers report C$33-35 a night (2024). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Facebook page as presence; Google listing at the pin, 4.2 over 49 reviews with phone; RV Life 4.5* over 16 reviews, $$ (C$26 avg ~ US$19, passes the Canada screen); OSM camp_site node 'Kona Beach' at the pin; RV Life 2024 firsthand stays at C$33-35
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 49.4027,-56.0836: trailer rows run along an open sand beach on the lake (shore elevation 17 m, not tidal), rows within ~10-20 m of the waterline with no treeline between; lakefront

name: Crowhill RV Park
note: RV park on Route 60 (Conception Bay Hwy) in Brigus, ~80 km west of St. John's; 118 sites, 3-way 30-amp hookups C$35 a night plus tax. Comfort station, convenience store, dump station, walking trail. Season about May 9-Oct 13. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: official NL tourism listing for the 2026 season (118 sites, 3-way 30A $35 + tax, May 9-Oct 13, phone; read 2026-10-07) plus Facebook page; Google 4.7 over 34 reviews; RV Life 4* $$ (C$30 avg ~ US$22); C$35 ~ US$25
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 47.5299,-53.2356: trailer loops on cleared ground north of Route 60; nearest water (Conception Bay inlet) ~350 m NW beyond houses and woods; not waterfront

name: Shark Cove Suites, RV Park & Campground
note: Small RV park with suites in Channel-Port aux Basques (16 Currie Ave), close to the Marine Atlantic ferry terminal; ~19 sites. Camping C$30-45 a night, taxes included. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: official NL tourism listing with camping prices ($30-45 taxes included, read 2026-10-07); Google 4.2 over 56 reviews with phone; RV Life lists it unrated; C$45 ~ US$32 under the $50 published-rate gate
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 47.5691,-59.1314: gravel pads beside the suites building inside the town grid; the open-ocean shore is ~250 m NE across rock barrens; not waterfront

name: Roache's Line RV Park
note: Large RV park on Roache's Line (Route 75 area) at Makinsons, ~100 sites, all full-hookup 30-amp (electric, water, sewer). Nightly C$40 plus tax, weekly $225, monthly $900; many sites are seasonal. Canteen. Reservations by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: roacheslinepark.com live with 2026 rates (nightly $40 + tax, weekly/monthly/seasonal; read 2026-10-07); Google 4.3 over 65 reviews with phone; RV Life lists it unrated; C$40 ~ US$29 under the $50 published-rate gate
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 47.5141,-53.2593 (pin moved ~200 m from the office onto the site loops): trailer loops on cleared hillside east of the road; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: The OldMill RV Park
note: Off-grid campground on the Main Brook salmon river at Avondale (72 Millville Rd): unserviced RV sites (C$22-25 a night) and a tenting field ($20), 137 sites with overflow areas. Day-use area with a small beach and swimming holes, playground; the old railbed trail starts at the gate. Open May-mid October. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: theoldmillrvpark.ca live with online booking; official NL tourism listing ($22-25 unserviced, $20 tent field, May 4-Oct 12; read 2026-10-07); Google 4.7 over 29 reviews with phone; RV Life lists it unrated; C$25 ~ US$18
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 47.3914,-53.2294 (pin moved ~120 m from the field onto the loops): RV loops run along the Main Brook, the westernmost sites ~10-30 m from the bank behind a thin line of trees, with an open grassed area at the river bend; canopy keeps the edge unconfirmed, default down; riverview

name: Pirate's Haven ATV Friendly RV Park & Chalets
note: RV park and chalets beside the Robinsons River at Robinsons (229 Main Rd), right on the T'Railway; full hookups C$35 a night (30-amp) / $40 (50-amp). Guided ATV tours and salmon fishing nearby. Season May 1-Oct 15. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: pirateshavenadventures.com live (park, chalets, tours); official NL tourism listing ($35 30A / $40 50A, May 1-Oct 15; read 2026-10-07); Coast Resorts Good Neighbor listing; Google 4.6 over 88 reviews with phone; a general RV park with an ATV side, not an off-road park; C$40 ~ US$29
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 48.2477,-58.7983: the southeast pull-through lot sits on an open gravel apron directly on the Robinsons River bank, front row ~15-30 m from the gravel bar with no treeline; riverfront

name: Brookdale Country Inn & RV Park
note: Family RV park beside a country inn at Bishop's Falls (10 Main St), just off the Trans-Canada; ~43 full-service sites (30/50 amp) plus semi-serviced and tent sites, C$35-45 a night. Heated in-ground pool, fire pits. Season about mid-May to mid-October. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: brookdaleinn.ca live with an RV park page (full-service sites, reservations); official NL tourism listing ($35-45 a night, May 16-Oct 13; read 2026-10-07); Google 4.5 over 65 reviews with phone; Good Sam lists it (unrated); C$45 ~ US$32
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 48.9909,-55.5409: site loops in trees beside the inn, south of the TCH interchange; a marshy pond ~150 m SE behind woods; not waterfront
